units.characteristics: the prophet's grief; sin as an incurable wound
units.gist: the LORD comes down to tread the high places; judgment for Jacob's transgression (idolatry as a prostitute's fee); 'for this I will lament and wail... her wound is incurable' - the prophet grieving a sin past cure

units.characteristics: the scheming, coveting interior; wanting only comfortable preaching
units.gist: 'woe to those who devise wickedness on their beds... they covet fields and seize them'; and the people who want only a preacher of 'wine and strong drink' - premeditated greed + the ear that wants comfort not truth

units.characteristics: the remnant gathered; the LORD at their head
units.gist: 'I will gather the remnant of Israel... their king passes on before them, the LORD at their head' - the scattered gathered under God's lead (hope amid judgment)

units.characteristics: inverted moral love (hating good, loving evil); the unanswered cry of the unjust
units.gist: the rulers 'who hate the good and love the evil', devouring my people's flesh; 'then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer... he will hide his face, because they made their deeds evil' - the inverted heart, its cry unanswered

prophets who cry 'Peace' when fed but declare war on those who don't feed them; against them 'I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the LORD, and with justice and might, to declare... his transgression' - prophecy for hire vs the Spirit-given courage to name sin

units.characteristics: injustice joined to false confidence in God's presence
units.gist: leaders who 'detest justice and make crooked the straight', judge for a bribe, yet 'lean on the LORD: is not the LORD in our midst? no disaster shall come' - the presumption of injustice that still claims God; Zion plowed as a field

units.characteristics: the resolved walk in the name of the LORD; the vision of peace
units.gist: the mountain of the LORD; nations beat swords into plowshares, sit unafraid under vine and fig tree; 'all the peoples walk each in the name of its god, but WE WILL WALK IN THE NAME OF THE LORD our God forever' - the resolved, differentiated walk

units.characteristics: hope through travail; God's hidden plan
units.gist: the lame made the remnant; Zion writhing 'like a woman in labor', rescued and redeemed in Babylon; 'they do not know the thoughts of the LORD, they do not understand his plan' - deliverance through pain, God's purpose hidden in the threshing

units.characteristics: the shepherd-ruler who is peace; the remnant; cut-off self-reliance
units.gist: from Bethlehem the ruler who 'shall stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the LORD... and he shall be their PEACE'; the remnant like dew and like a lion; God cuts off horses, strongholds, sorceries, idols - security relocated from self to the shepherd

units.characteristics: what the LORD requires: do justice, love kindness, walk humbly
units.gist: THE GEM - the covenant lawsuit ('O my people, what have I done to you?'); the escalating offerings ('thousands of rams? my firstborn?'); 'He has told you, O man, what is good: to DO JUSTICE, and to LOVE KINDNESS, and to WALK HUMBLY with your God' - the whole inner-outer life in three

units.characteristics: the fraudulent interior; the curse of dissatisfaction
units.gist: treasures of wickedness, wicked scales, deceitful weights, tongues of lies; 'you shall eat but NOT BE SATISFIED, and there shall be hunger within you' - fraud met by an emptiness that consumes what it gains (the never-satisfied curse, w/ Ecc)

units.characteristics: the collapse of trust; the turn to wait on God
units.gist: GEM - 'the godly has perished from the earth... put no trust in a neighbour... a man's enemies are the men of his own house'; then the turn: 'But as for me, I WILL LOOK TO THE LORD; I will WAIT for the God of my salvation; my God will hear me'

units.characteristics: resilient waiting under judgment; light in darkness
units.gist: GEM - 'when I FALL, I shall RISE; when I sit in DARKNESS, the LORD will be a LIGHT to me'; 'I will bear the indignation of the LORD because I have sinned, until he pleads my cause' - hope that owns its guilt and waits through the dark

units.characteristics: the incomparable pardoning God who delights in steadfast love
units.gist: GEM - 'WHO IS A GOD LIKE YOU, pardoning iniquity and passing over transgression... he does not retain his anger, because he DELIGHTS IN STEADFAST LOVE. He will again have compassion... cast all our sins into the depths of the sea'
